Tonight's Special Guest

Buster

The Late Late Dog Show

beats.text: Tonight on the Late Late Dog Show... Buster!
Welcome back! Tonight's special guest — fresh from destroying the couch — it's Buster!
So, Buster, tell us about James.
James? Oh, where do I even start.
Apparently it's your 50th birthday. Huge achievement. You've survived another year despite needing me to supervise literally every meal.
James supports Arsenal and talks about them constantly. And honestly? We love you for it. Mostly.
You do he thinks he is good at golf, and somehow we all still adore you.
he falls asleep on the sofa every evening. It's part of your charm. A strange part, but still.
Let's be honest about he claims Buster loves him most even though Sophie feeds him. It's funny because it's true, sweetie.
he still talks about his university days. The whole family laughs about it. With love. Mostly.
James, you're my favourite human in the whole world, and I mean that sincerely.
Everybody — Buster has spoken! Give it up for Buster!
Happy 50th Dad. Love Sophie and Buster.
